Output is saved to job log excerpt (not syslog).

Arguments.Description: ID of the rsync task to run immediately.

Fields.Name: Archive
Fields.Description: Make rsync run recursively, preserving symlinks, permissions, modification times, group, and special files.

Fields.Name: Compress
Fields.Description: Reduce the size of the data to be transmitted.

Fields.Name: Delayupdates
Fields.Description: Delay updating destination files until all transfers are complete.

Fields.Name: Delete
Fields.Description: Delete files in the destination directory that do not exist in the source directory.

Fields.Name: Desc
Fields.Description: Description of the rsync task.

Fields.Name: Direction
Fields.Description: Specify if data should be PULLED or PUSHED from the remote system.

Fields.Name: Enabled
Fields.Description: Whether this rsync task is enabled.

Fields.Name: Extra
Fields.Description: Array of additional rsync command-line options.

Fields.Name: Mode
Fields.Description: Operating mechanism for Rsync, i.e. Rsync Module mode or Rsync SSH mode.

Fields.Name: Path
Fields.Description: Local filesystem path to synchronize.

Fields.Name: Preserveattr
Fields.Description: Preserve extended attributes of files.

Fields.Name: Preserveperm
Fields.Description: Preserve original file permissions.

Fields.Name: Quiet
Fields.Description: Suppress informational messages from rsync.

Fields.Name: Recursive
Fields.Description: Recursively transfer subdirectories.

Fields.Name: Remotehost
Fields.Description: IP address or hostname of the remote system. If username differs on the remote host, "username@remote_host"     format should be used.

Fields.Name: Remotemodule
Fields.Description: Name of remote module, this attribute should be specified when `mode` is set to MODULE.

Fields.Name: Remotepath
Fields.Description: Path on the remote system to synchronize with.

Fields.Name: Remoteport
Fields.Description: Port number for SSH connection. Only applies when `mode` is SSH.

Fields.Name: Schedule
Fields.Description: Cron schedule for when the rsync task should run.

Fields.Name: SshCredentials
Fields.Description: Keychain credential ID for SSH authentication. `null` to use user's SSH keys.

Fields.Name: SshKeyscan
Fields.Description: Automatically add remote host key to user's known_hosts file.

Fields.Name: Times
Fields.Description: Preserve modification times of files.

Fields.Name: User
Fields.Description: Username to run the rsync task as.

Fields.Name: ValidateRpath
Fields.Description: Validate the existence of the remote path.

Fields.Description:

Fields.Description: An array of field names describing the manner in which query results should be ordered.
